placeholders.description: List of all the currently active connection modes.
The preferred connection mode in use.
Icon selected from format-icons according to the signal quality.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. This format is used when other formats aren't specified.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-failed.label: What to show when failed
format-failed.doc: This format is used when the modem cannot start.
format-failed.description: This format is used when the modem cannot start.

format-locked.label: What to show when locked
format-locked.doc: This format is used when the SIM on the modem is locked.
format-locked.description: This format is used when the SIM on the modem is locked.

format-disabled.label: What to show when turned off
format-disabled.doc: This format is used when the modem is disabled.
format-disabled.description: This format is used when the modem is disabled.

format-enabled.label: What to show when enabled
format-enabled.doc: This format is used when the modem is enabled, but isn't registered to any carrier network.
format-enabled.description: This format is used when the modem is enabled, but isn't registered to any carrier network.

format-searching.label: What to show when searching
format-searching.doc: This format is used when the modem is looking for a carrier network to register to.
format-searching.description: This format is used when the modem is looking for a carrier network to register to.

format-registered.label: What to show when registered
format-registered.doc: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, but no data connection is active.
format-registered.description: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, but no data connection is active.

format-connected.label: What to show when connected
format-connected.doc: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, and there is an active data connection.
format-connected.description: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, and there is an active data connection.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: Based on the current signal strength, the corresponding icon gets selected. The order is low to high. Or by the state if it is an object.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed in the tooltip. This format is used when other formats aren't specified.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

tooltip-format-failed.label: Tooltip when failed
tooltip-format-failed.doc: This format is used when the modem cannot start.
tooltip-format-failed.description: This format is used when the modem cannot start.

tooltip-format-locked.label: Tooltip when locked
tooltip-format-locked.doc: This format is used when the SIM on the modem is locked.
tooltip-format-locked.description: This format is used when the SIM on the modem is locked.

tooltip-format-disabled.label: Tooltip when turned off
tooltip-format-disabled.doc: This format is used when the modem is disabled.
tooltip-format-disabled.description: This format is used when the modem is disabled.

tooltip-format-enabled.label: Tooltip when enabled
tooltip-format-enabled.doc: This format is used when the modem is enabled, but isn't registered to any carrier network.
tooltip-format-enabled.description: This format is used when the modem is enabled, but isn't registered to any carrier network.

tooltip-format-searching.label: Tooltip when searching
tooltip-format-searching.doc: This format is used when the modem is looking for a carrier network to register to.
tooltip-format-searching.description: This format is used when the modem is looking for a carrier network to register to.

tooltip-format-registered.label: Tooltip when registered
tooltip-format-registered.doc: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, but no data connection is active.
tooltip-format-registered.description: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, but no data connection is active.

tooltip-format-connected.label: Tooltip when connected
tooltip-format-connected.doc: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, and there is an active data connection.
tooltip-format-connected.description: This format is used when the modem is registered to a network, and there is an active data connection.

interval.label: Refresh every
interval.doc: The interval in which the WWAN information gets polled (e.g. carrier name).
interval.description: How often the module updates its information.

imei.label: Imei
imei.doc: Select only the modem with the corresponding imei.
imei.description: Select only the modem with the corresponding imei.

path.label: Path
path.doc: Select only the modem with the corresponding hardware path.
path.description: Select only the modem with the corresponding hardware path.

hide-disconnected.label: Hide disconnected
hide-disconnected.doc: Defines if the module should be hidden while the modem does not have an active data connection.
hide-disconnected.description: Defines if the module should be hidden while the modem does not have an active data connection.
